document.abstract: A small camera is described which takes 1/5 by 2 1/2 in. pictures at rates up to 450 frames/sec on 70mm film. The film is stationary during exposure. The total weight of the camera is 25 lb. Its long thin aperture shape, its high frame rate and its small size should make it a useful tool for work in ordnance and in aircraft and machine design.
